items.description: Show the terminal cursor while still positioning it for IME support

items.description: Horizontal padding for input editor (0-3)

items.label: Autocomplete max items
items.description: Max visible items in autocomplete dropdown (3-20)

items.label: Clear on shrink
items.description: Clear empty rows when content shrinks (may cause flicker)

items.label: Terminal progress
items.description: Show OSC 9;4 progress indicators in the terminal tab bar

items.label: Steering mode
items.description: Enter while streaming queues steering messages. 'one-at-a-time': deliver one, wait for response. 'all': deliver all at once.

items.label: Follow-up mode
items.description: Alt+Enter queues follow-up messages until agent stops. 'one-at-a-time': deliver one, wait for response. 'all': deliver all at once.

items.label: Transport
items.description: Preferred transport for providers that support multiple transports

items.label: HTTP idle timeout
items.description: Maximum idle gap while waiting for HTTP headers or body chunks. Disable for local models that pause longer than five minutes.

items.label: Hide thinking
items.description: Hide thinking blocks in assistant responses

items.label: Collapse changelog
items.description: Show condensed changelog after updates

items.label: Quiet startup
items.description: Disable verbose printing at startup

items.label: Install telemetry
items.description: Send an anonymous version/update ping after changelog-detected updates

items.label: Double-escape action
items.description: Action when pressing Escape twice with empty editor

items.label: Tree filter mode
items.description: Default filter when opening /tree

items.label: Warnings
items.description: Enable or disable individual warnings

items.label: Thinking level
items.description: Reasoning depth for thinking-capable models
